strict_assessment: Current red oval fish does not preserve the blobfish’s distinctive soft head/face and deep-bodied proportions. Rebuild the head and body rather than relying on color.
Current bell/jelly-like body is not a cuttlefish. Use a broad oval mantle, continuous lateral fin skirt, visible cephalopod head, eight arms, and two feeding tentacles.
Current rabbit/deer-like quadruped is not a fox body. Use a small canine torso, canine paws/hocks, tapered muzzle, huge ears, and a full bushy tail.
Current elegant wader/peacock-like bird misses the raptor body. Use a raptor head and hooked bill, long powerful legs, crest quills, compact wings, and long tail.
Current palm-like trunk/crown does not match a banana plant. Use a giant herb with overlapping pseudostem, very broad torn leaves, and a hanging banana bunch with terminal flower.
